label: Release a new version in GitHub
command: echo 'Release CCD-Plugin' && echo '==================' && echo '' && echo 'Recent tags:' && git tag --sort=-creatordate | head -5 && echo '' && read -p 'Enter version to release: ' VERSION && [[ "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid version. Use major.minor or major.minor.patch.' >&2; exit 1; } && git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || { echo 'Commit or stash all tracked changes before creating a release tag.' >&2; exit 1; } && METADATA_VERSION=$(git show HEAD:metadata.txt | sed -n 's/^version=//p') && [ "$METADATA_VERSION" = "$VERSION" ] || { echo "Committed metadata.txt version '$METADATA_VERSION' does not match '$VERSION'." >&2; exit 1; } && git tag "$VERSION" && git push origin "$VERSION" && echo '' && echo "Tag '$VERSION' pushed. GitHub Actions will create the plugin and extlibs release."

label: Build local plugin package
command: echo 'Build CCD-Plugin package' && echo '========================' && echo '' && LATEST=$(git tag --sort=-creatordate | head -1) && read -p "Enter version (latest tag: $LATEST): " VERSION && [[ "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid version. Use major.minor or major.minor.patch.' >&2; exit 1; } && STAGE_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ccd-plugin-stage.XXXXXX) && trap 'rm -rf "$STAGE_DIR"' EXIT && python scripts/stage_plugin.py "$STAGE_DIR" && git -C "$STAGE_DIR" init -q && git -C "$STAGE_DIR" config user.name zed-package && git -C "$STAGE_DIR" config user.email zed-package@example.invalid && git -C "$STAGE_DIR" add . && git -C "$STAGE_DIR" commit -qm 'Stage local package' && cd "$STAGE_DIR" && uvx --from qgis-plugin-ci==2.10.0 qgis-plugin-ci package "$VERSION" --disable-submodule-update && cp "CCD_Plugin.$VERSION.zip" "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/" && echo '' && echo "Package created: CCD_Plugin.$VERSION.zip"
